mergeConflicts.pageSubtitle: When two provisioning paths detect the same person under different user accounts, a merge conflict is raised. Review each conflict and choose whether to link the incoming user to the existing actor, or create a separate actor explicitly. All decisions are audited.
mergeConflicts.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why you're linking or separating these identities…
mergeConflicts.reasonRequired: A reason is required before resolving.
mergeConflicts.infoLink: Link to existing — records the incoming user as resolved against the existing actor. Identity connection only — no change to commission, payout, attribution, or compensation.
mergeConflicts.infoSeparate: Create separate — creates a new, explicitly-audited actor for the incoming user via the override path. No silent duplicates; full audit trail.
mergeConflicts.successLink: Conflict resolved — incoming user linked to existing actor.
mergeConflicts.successSeparate: Conflict resolved — separate actor created for incoming user.
mergeConflicts.alreadyResolved: This conflict has already been resolved.
